text.en:
Hanbros Turkey Office — Delivery & Import Operations

Our Turkey operations centre manages import clearance, inland distribution and final mile delivery for every consignment arriving from the United Kingdom and Europe.

When your goods reach Turkish customs, our local team takes over — ensuring smooth clearance, accurate duty calculation and prompt delivery to Istanbul, Ankara, Izmir and addresses nationwide.

Turkey Office Services

  • Import customs clearance — personal effects, commercial and vehicle imports.
  • Door-to-door delivery — nationwide Turkish distribution.
  • Customer liaison — Turkish-language support for recipients.
  • Storage & holding — short-term warehousing if delivery is delayed.
  • Documentation — import permits and local registration guidance.

Hanbros UK — seamless handover from UK export to Turkish delivery.
